apk.releaseNotes:
GrowthIntel 2.5.31

We’re back, improved and stronger.

• Improved app connectivity and automatic recovery.
• Your existing account, trade history, saved research and settings stay with you.
• Improved update checks and downloads, including OTA support for version 2.5.24.
• Improved background learning reliability.
• Smoother phone controls and scrolling.

Open the app online to download the OTA update, then background and reopen it to apply. You can also install the new APK over your existing app.
